description: This is a Python source file defining functions for processing energy consumption CSV data. It includes utilities for decoding, parsing, normalizing units, deduplicating, sorting data points, computing statistics, and processing CSV to output structured results including detected anomalies.

classes.name: ProcessedResult
classes.description: Data class representing the structured result after processing CSV data, including metrics, data points, and anomalies.

methods.name: str _decode_csv_bytes(raw_bytes: bytes)
methods.description: Decodes raw bytes of CSV input using UTF-8 with BOM handling.

methods.name: Optional[datetime] _try_parse_datetime(s: str)
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string into a datetime object, supporting ISO format and trailing 'Z'.

methods.name: Optional[float] _normalize_unit_to_kwh_multiplier(unit_raw: str)
methods.description: Normalizes units like kWh, Wh, MWh to a conversion multiplier to kWh.

methods.name: Optional[float] _to_float(value: str)
methods.description: Converts a string to float, removing commas and handling invalid or infinite values.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _dedupe(items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Removes duplicate entries based on timestamp and energy value.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _sort_by_timestamp(items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Sorts entries by timestamp, parsing date when possible.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float,float] _compute_stats(values: List[float])
methods.description: Calculates total, minimum, and maximum energy from a list of values.

methods.name: ProcessedResult process_csv_bytes( raw_bytes: bytes, timestamp_col: str, energy_col: str, unit_col: str, )
methods.description: Main function to process CSV bytes, extract energy data, identify anomalies, and output a structured result with statistics.
